spans.s: अज्येष्ठ ajyeSTha adj. nominal plural of which none is the eldest अज्येष्ठ ajyeSTha adj. not the oldest or best
अज्येष्ठवृत्ति ajyeSThavRtti adj. or behaving like one who has no elder brother अज्येष्ठवृत्ति ajyeSThavRtti adj. not behaving as the eldest brother
अज्यायस् ajyAyas adj. not greater than
आज्यन्त Ajyanta m. goal in a race-course
आज्य Ajya m. descendant of aja आज्य Ajya n. melted or clarified butter
